stem: Which sentence best expresses the article’s main idea?

options.label: F
options.text: No one talks like that casually—or should.

options.label: G
options.text: Texting has long been bemoaned as the downfall of the written word, “penmanship for illiterates,” as one critic called it.

options.label: H
options.text: Of course no one thinks about that consciously.

options.label: J
options.text: Texting, far from being a scourge, is a work in progress.
